lines.beaver: 새로 온 인턴 정민호 씨랑 일해 봤죠? 어때요?
lines.beaver_en: You've worked with the new intern, Jeong Minho, right? How is he?
lines.beaver_roman: saero on inteon jeongminho ssirang ilhae bwatjyo? eottaeyo?
lines.learner: 네, 정말 점잖은 사람이에요. 말도 조심스럽게 해요.
lines.en: Yes, he's really well-mannered. He speaks carefully, too.
lines.roman: ne, jeongmal jeomjaneun saramieyo. maldo josimseureopge haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? Is he good at his work?
lines.learner: 머리가 좋아서 일을 여간 빨리 배우는 게 아니에요.
lines.en: He's smart, so he learns the work incredibly fast.
lines.roman: meoriga joaseo ireul yeogan ppalli baeuneun ge anieyo.

lines.beaver_en: What about his personality? Does he get angry easily?
lines.en: No, he's gentle and very kind-hearted.

lines.beaver_en: Does he read the room well?
lines.learner: 눈치가 여간 빠르지 않아요. 제 기분을 금방 알아요.
lines.en: He's extremely quick at reading people. He notices my mood right away.
lines.roman: nunchiga yeogan ppareuji anayo. je gibuneul geumbang arayo.

lines.en: Yes, he's frank and honest. He's a conscientious person.

lines.beaver_en: He doesn't show off, does he?
lines.learner: 능력이 있어도 잘난 척을 안 해요. 인격이 좋아요.
lines.en: Even though he's capable, he doesn't show off. He has good character.
lines.roman: neungnyeogi isseodo jallan cheogeul an haeyo. ingyeogi joayo.

lines.learner: 호기심이 많아서 질문이 여간 많은 것이 아니에요.
lines.en: He's so curious that he asks a huge number of questions.
lines.roman: hogisimi manaseo jilmuni yeogan maneun geosi anieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Does he make mistakes at work?
lines.en: Even when he makes mistakes, he bravely tries again.

lines.beaver_en: How is he when something urgent comes up?
lines.en: He senses danger first, by instinct.

lines.beaver_en: That's a lot of praise. He sounds great to work with.
lines.learner: 네, 사람이 좋아서 여간 편한 게 아니에요.
lines.en: Yes, he's a good person, so it's really comfortable.
lines.roman: ne, sarami joaseo yeogan pyeonhan ge anieyo.
